One amount invested once and compounded through every test year (2000 to mid-2021), not a fresh amount each year. Weekly closes, log scale. Each year's portfolio is built from the 4 years before it and held, unchanged, for the next year. Click a name to show or hide it.

Drawdown from running peak

How far each strategy is below its own highest value so far (0% = at a new high, −40% = 40% below its peak). Plotted once a week from January 2000 to June 2021, so the axis shows years. Same strategies and trading costs as the chart above.

The 15 holdings and how they did

Weight from Goal Programming (2% to 15%). Score is the Integer Programming selection score. Return, volatility, Sharpe, beta and drawdown are training-window values; the last four columns are the test year. Contribution = weight × test-year return. Invested = the portfolio's value at the start of that year (from the amount invested in January 2000) × weight; P&L = invested × test-year return, before trading costs.

Behavioural clusters this year

Cluster numbers are arbitrary; the description names features at least half a standard deviation from the window average.

Choosing K

Silhouette score per candidate K. K is the best-scoring value that lets the selection take 15 stocks with at most 3 per cluster from at least 5 clusters; faded bars cannot.
